sections.label: Savings Bonds programme launch results
sections.summary: Since September 2015, around 35,000 individuals have invested S$970 million into 14 Savings Bonds issues.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) and Second Minister for Defence (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Since the launch of the programme in September 2015, around 35,000 individuals, from all age groups, have invested S$970 million into 14 Savings Bonds issues.

sections.label: Savings Bonds withdrawal and interest rates
sections.summary: Investors can withdraw money with interest monthly without penalty, and interest rates have declined due to lower global bond yields.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) and Second Minister for Defence (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Although Savings Bonds mature in 10 years, an investor can withdraw some or all of the money invested, with interest, in any given month without penalty.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) and Second Minister for Defence (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Over the past several months, Savings Bond interest rates have declined due to lower global bond yields.

sections.label: MAS public education outreach
sections.summary: MAS reaches out through publicity campaigns and community outreach, working with partners to educate the public about Savings Bonds.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) and Second Minister for Defence (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: MAS has been reaching out to the public through publicity campaigns and community outreach activities.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) and Second Minister for Defence (Mr Ong Ye Kung) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: In particular, MAS has been working with partners, such as MoneySENSE, the Institute of Financial Literacy and grassroots organisations, to educate the public about Savings Bonds.

sections.label: Saving virtue and publicity timing
sections.summary: Saving is a good virtue, and another publicity effort is intended but must be timed properly, such as after the US Presidential Election.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Saving is, indeed, a good virtue and I hope you can play your part, too, and explain to the young.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: We intend to launch another publicity effort, but this has to be timed properly, such as waiting until the US Presidential Election is over!
